integrity: Full proof with explicit affine candidate coordinates, squared-distance branch inequalities, endpoint analysis, local multipliers, and a standalone exact-rational diagnostic. Finite diagnostics are not universal proofs. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exactly least periods 3 and 4 only, on the complete three-line farthest-projection map with tie-as-fixed rule; no global basin or higher-period classification. The period-three part is known prior work, not claimed new.
title: A golden-ratio coexistence window for attracting triangle-projection cycles
